layers.kicker: How a Bosco line is built
layers.title: Four layers. One factory that actually ships.
layers.subtitle: Scroll to stack each layer of the operation — filling, packaging, materials, and the service that keeps them alive.

items.title: Automated liquid filling that never misses a millilitre.
items.body: High-speed rotary and linear fillers calibrated for food, pharma, and chemical plants.

items.title: Sealing, boxing, and labeling in one continuous motion.
items.body: From vacuum sealers to multi-format cartoners, Bosco lines stitch packaging steps into a single flow.

items.title: Factory-grade inputs, sourced and certified before they arrive.
items.body: Pharmaceutical APIs, food-grade resins, and industrial chemicals arrive with full traceability.

items.title: The parts and people that keep the line running overnight.
items.body: Motors, sensors, seals, and on-call technicians across the region.

advantage.title: Why Industry Leaders
advantage.body: We don't just sell machines; we architect end-to-end industrial production ecosystems. From factory planning to 24/7 post-installation maintenance, Bosco ensures zero downtime.
points: Custom-engineered production lines tailored to your floor

about.hero: We connect factories with the machinery, raw materials, and commercial pathways they need to grow — across food, pharmaceutical, and industrial supply chains.
about.story1: Bosco International Trade operates at the intersection of industrial technology and commercial execution. We help manufacturers source equipment, secure materials, and bring products to market with confidence.
about.story2: From project planning to long-term supply partnerships, our team supports every stage of your production journey.

pillars.title: Precision Sourcing
pillars.text: We identify the right machinery and materials for regulated, high-volume production environments.

pillars.title: Trusted Supply
pillars.text: Every partnership is built on reliability, compliance, and long-term industrial performance.

pillars.title: Global Reach

about.journeyLead: A consistent focus on quality sourcing, trusted partnerships, and practical support for modern manufacturing teams.
